verdict.rationale: ReadMe documents a ReadMe API for controlling docs programmatically, plus a Developer Metrics API, API-based export, the official rdme CLI, and Git-based workflows that let docs and OpenAPI files be managed outside the UI. Nothing in the evidence claims or shows that the API matches the UI feature for feature. Many UI-configured features (custom domain, appearance/theming, reviews, linter/audit, AI agent) have no documented API equivalent. Missing for 10: an explicit UI-to-API parity claim, documented API coverage for configuration, admin and AI features, and independent hands-on corroboration.
